title: examples: author the first dataset vocabulary on app-crm (and hotcrm) for the D5 measurement (ADR-0149 D7 card 6)
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2eAG5J8aqAyPZif4BJ

Filing gate: ② a child card of an Accepted ADR. [ADR-0149](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0149-ai-answers-business-questions-through-the-dataset-semantic-layer.md) D7 card 6. Parent: #31503, landed by PR #31535.
Reader: triage routes it (the ADR names `domain:examples`, which has no label in this repo), plus objectstack-ai/hotcrm for its eight datasets (a hotcrm card is owed when this one is picked up). This card starts after the spec card for D1 lands.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "crm_opportunity_metrics synonyms" found nothing.

## 维护者速读

- **问题：** 给示例应用写第一批业务词汇：同义词和业务定义。这也是 D5 评测前后对比的第一份数据。
- **影响面：** 只动示例元数据，不改平台行为。
- **需要您做的：** 无。

## Task

- [ ] **D1, as the first authored data for D5:** add `synonyms` and `description` to `examples/app-crm`'s `crm_opportunity_metrics`.
- [ ] Do the same for hotcrm's eight datasets, in objectstack-ai/hotcrm.
- [ ] Each `description` is a business definition in plain words, not a prompt (M1 A).
